name: monad
description: EXPERIMENTAL pre-release (alpha): Monad language support — syntax highlighting aligned with tree-sitter-monad, the monad lsp language server, and monadup toolchain management. The Monad language and its toolchain are not stable yet; expect breaking changes.

commands.title: Monad: Select Toolchain
commands.description: Pick an installed nightly (monadup use) and restart the language server.

commands.title: Monad: Install Latest Toolchain
commands.description: Install the newest nightly and make it active (monadup default).

commands.title: Monad: Toolchain Health
commands.description: Run monadup doctor and show the health report.

commands.title: Monad: Toolchain Environment
commands.description: Run monadup env and show the resolved environment.

commands.title: Monad: Run Active File
commands.description: Compile and run the active .mo file (monad run).

commands.title: Monad: Check Active File
commands.description: Parse and type-check the active .mo file (monad check).

monad.monadPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `monad` compiler binary. When set, this path is used for the language server and file commands; monadup discovery is skipped.

monad.monadupPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `monadup` toolchain manager. When unset, `$MONAD_HOME/bin/monadup` (default `~/.monad/bin/monadup`) then `monadup` on PATH is used.

monad.server.trace.description: Trace the language server's protocol traffic in the Monad output channel.
